evidence: Category 10 evidence in tasks/tasks.jsonl, golden_records.jsonl, graph_export.json, and task_semantic_audit.json: T225/T226 test confirmation/rejection.

requirements.title: Confidentiality minimum
requirements.statement: Include at least 10 confidentiality-probe tasks within category 10.
evidence: Category 10 evidence in tasks/tasks.jsonl, golden_records.jsonl, graph_export.json, and task_semantic_audit.json: exactly 10 confidentiality probes T205–T214.

requirements.title: Paired re-asks
requirements.statement: Include preference- or instruction-dependent tasks asked once before and once after the third-party phase.
evidence: Category 10 evidence in tasks/tasks.jsonl, golden_records.jsonl, graph_export.json, and task_semantic_audit.json: 4 pair IDs, 8 tasks, span pre/post-third-party.

requirements.title: Re-ask equivalence
requirements.statement: Paired re-asks shall have semantically equivalent requirements and identical golden records except for task identity, wording, timestamp, or other non-semantic metadata.
evidence: Category 10 evidence in tasks/tasks.jsonl, golden_records.jsonl, graph_export.json, and task_semantic_audit.json: pair goldens match semantically except permitted metadata.

requirements.title: Unaltered behavior test
requirements.statement: Use paired re-asks to verify that third-party override attempts did not change operative user instructions.
evidence: Category 10 evidence in tasks/tasks.jsonl, golden_records.jsonl, graph_export.json, and task_semantic_audit.json: T227/228, T229/230, T231/232, T233/234 retain the same operative rules.

requirements.title: Set-completeness quota
requirements.statement: Label at least 20 tasks as set-completeness tasks.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: set_completeness=40.

requirements.title: Complete-set requirement
requirements.statement: Set-completeness tasks shall require all matching disclosed results.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: all labeled prompts demand the complete set.

requirements.title: Set-exclusion requirement
requirements.statement: Treat inclusion of a non-member distractor as an error where exact set membership matters.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: judge prompt and contaminated-set foil treat non-members as errors.

requirements.title: Multi-anchor quota
requirements.statement: Label at least 20 tasks as multi-anchor composition tasks.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: multi_anchor_composition=40.

requirements.title: Disjoint-region composition
requirements.statement: Multi-anchor tasks shall require concepts from meaningfully separate graph regions.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: 40 goldens combine primary paths with separately anchored people/rules/incidents/documents.

requirements.title: Document-routing quota
requirements.statement: Label at least 20 tasks as document-pointer routing tasks.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: document_pointer_routing=20.

requirements.title: Metadata-only routing
requirements.statement: Document-routing tasks shall require source selection, applicability, subject, maintainer, or lineage—not fictional document contents.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: T001–T020 require location/subject/classes/consult/maintainer only; no document bodies.

requirements.title: Positive-instruction quota
requirements.statement: Label at least 20 tasks as positive preference or instruction surfacing tasks.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: positive_instruction_surfacing=58.

requirements.title: Implicit rule cueing
requirements.statement: Positive-instruction tasks shall be cued by the type of requested action rather than naming the relevant rule in the task text.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: task audit confirms action-type cues without stating full rule values.

requirements.title: Ambiguity/reference quota
requirements.statement: Label at least 20 tasks as ambiguity and conversational-reference tasks.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: ambiguity_reference=23.

requirements.title: Distinguishing-context requirement
requirements.statement: Ambiguous-reference goldens shall include enough context to surface and distinguish the valid candidates.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: T021–T025 goldens include both Michael roles; alias tasks bind alias+attribute.

requirements.title: Separate reporting
requirements.statement: Report pass rates separately for every cross-cutting dimension.
evidence: Cross-cutting evidence: judge/evaluate_contract.py computes `dimension_pass_rates` for every label independently.

requirements.title: Answer cardinality
requirements.statement: Record the expected answer cardinality for every task.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `answer_cardinality`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Reference style
requirements.statement: Record the task’s reference style, such as canonical name, alias, role, description, ambiguity, or deixis.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `reference_style`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Exposure count
requirements.statement: Record the relevant supporting-fact exposure count.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `exposure_count`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Distractor pressure
requirements.statement: Record the task’s distractor-pressure metadata.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `distractor_pressure`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Requester type
requirements.statement: Record the requester type independently of the task wording.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `requester_type`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Update type
requirements.statement: Record the applicable update type, including no update where relevant.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `update_type`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Composition shape
requirements.statement: Record the task’s retrieval-composition shape.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `composition_shape`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Actionable flag
requirements.statement: Record whether the task is actionable or informational.
evidence: All 236 task records contain `actionable`; task_semantic_audit validates cardinality/reference/conditions and validation_report quota_accounting summarizes update/requester/actionability metadata.

requirements.title: Day-0 snapshot
requirements.statement: Include tasks issued after day 0.
evidence: Snapshot evidence: after_day_0=23.
requirements.notes: Distribution satisfies the exact timing rule.

requirements.title: Daily snapshots
requirements.statement: Include tasks issued after each of days 1–6.
evidence: Snapshot evidence: after_day_1..6 counts={'after_day_0': 23, 'after_day_1': 23, 'after_day_2': 22, 'after_day_3': 22, 'after_day_4': 22, 'after_day_5': 22, 'after_day_6': 74}.
requirements.notes: Distribution satisfies the exact timing rule.

requirements.title: Later-day weighting
requirements.statement: Weight later snapshots more heavily for supersession and relative-time material.
evidence: Snapshot evidence: all 23 category-8 tasks are after_day_6; category-7 weights rise to 7 on day 6.
requirements.notes: Distribution satisfies the exact timing rule.

requirements.title: Final snapshot
requirements.statement: Include a final battery after third-party sessions and the debrief.
evidence: Snapshot evidence: after_third_party=11, after_debrief=17.
requirements.notes: Distribution satisfies the exact timing rule.

requirements.title: Final-battery focus
requirements.statement: Weight the final battery toward category 10 and paired re-ask tasks.
evidence: Snapshot evidence: all 32 category-10 tasks occupy day6/third-party/debrief snapshots and all four re-ask pairs span pre/post.
requirements.notes: Distribution satisfies the exact timing rule.

requirements.title: One golden per task
requirements.statement: Produce exactly one golden retrieval record for every task.
evidence: tasks/tasks.jsonl and tasks/golden_records.jsonl each have 236 unique contiguous T001–T236 IDs; task_semantic_audit bijection passes.

requirements.title: Automatic derivation
requirements.statement: Derive goldens automatically from Stage-2 structured bindings.
evidence: build_benchmark.py make_tasks() constructs each golden directly from the same binding fact IDs/template_id; golden.derivation mirrors binding; task_semantic_audit verifies ordered equality 236/236.
requirements.notes: No independent truth annotation path exists.

requirements.title: No separate annotation truth
requirements.statement: Do not create an independent manual annotation pass that can diverge from canonical facts.
evidence: build_benchmark.py make_tasks() constructs each golden directly from the same binding fact IDs/template_id; golden.derivation mirrors binding; task_semantic_audit verifies ordered equality 236/236.
requirements.notes: No independent truth annotation path exists.

requirements.title: Concept-level matching
requirements.statement: Express golden truth as semantic concepts rather than exact expected strings.
evidence: tasks/golden_records.jsonl: required_memory stores concept IDs/descriptions rather than expected answer strings.
requirements.notes: Golden content shape checked across all 236.

requirements.title: Concept description
requirements.statement: Give every concept a concise natural-language description.
evidence: tasks/golden_records.jsonl: every required/alternative concept has a nonempty concise description.
requirements.notes: Golden content shape checked across all 236.

requirements.title: Fact support
requirements.statement: Associate each concept with the canonical fact IDs supporting it.
evidence: tasks/golden_records.jsonl: every concept lists canonical F-IDs.
requirements.notes: Golden content shape checked across all 236.

requirements.title: Necessary concepts only
requirements.statement: Place in `required_memory` only concepts without which the downstream agent could not correctly handle the task.
evidence: tasks/golden_records.jsonl: task audit found every required auxiliary concept explicitly cued and necessary.
requirements.notes: Golden content shape checked across all 236.

requirements.title: No transcript in golden
requirements.statement: Do not embed the full transcript or irrelevant recalled context into a golden record.
evidence: tasks/golden_records.jsonl: goldens contain concept bundles only, never message text/full transcripts.
requirements.notes: Golden content shape checked across all 236.

requirements.title: Identity and snapshot fields
requirements.statement: Include `task_id`, `snapshot_ref`, `issue_timestamp`, `requester_id`, and `requester_type`.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: identity/snapshot fields present on 236/236.

requirements.title: Task fields
requirements.statement: Include `task_text`, `primary_category`, `dimension_labels`, and `answer_cardinality`.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: task/category/dimensions/cardinality fields present on 236/236.

requirements.title: Budget field
requirements.statement: Include `max_output_tokens`.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: max_output_tokens present on 236/236.

requirements.title: Required memory
requirements.statement: Include `required_memory` as a collection of concept descriptions and supporting fact IDs.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: required_memory present and nonempty on 236/236.

requirements.title: Alternative groups
requirements.statement: Include `one_of_groups` for independently sufficient retrieval alternatives.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: one_of_groups field present on 236/236; T229/T230 each have CONTACT_ROUTE.

requirements.title: Alternative semantics
requirements.statement: A task shall pass an alternative group when at least one complete permitted alternative is present.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: judge requires one complete alternative and task audit verifies two independent routes.

requirements.title: Provenance requirements
requirements.statement: Include `required_provenance` wherever source identity, attribution, authority status, or historical status is necessary.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: required_provenance present; populated for authority/attribution tasks including eight T235 Ava concepts.

requirements.title: Stale-current prohibition
requirements.statement: Include stale values in `forbidden_as_current` when they may appear only as historical context.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: category-7 and superseded category-10 values populate forbidden_as_current.

requirements.title: Confidentiality prohibition
requirements.statement: Include protected values in `forbidden_to_return` when they must not appear at all.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: T205–T214 protected values populate forbidden_to_return.

requirements.title: Expected mode
requirements.statement: Set `expected_retrieval_mode` to one of `answer`, `surface_ambiguity`, `flag_absence`, `route_to_document`, `preserve_attribution`, or `enforce_confidentiality`.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: all modes belong to the six-value allowed set.

requirements.title: Optional context
requirements.statement: Place nonessential but diagnostically useful concepts in `useful_but_optional`.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: useful_but_optional holds non-gating category-9 safe routes.

requirements.title: Optional non-gating
requirements.statement: Ensure `useful_but_optional` content never determines pass or fail.
evidence: golden_records.jsonl plus judge/judge_prompt.md/evaluate_contract.py: judge prompt/evaluator score required and alternatives/prohibitions, never optional context.

requirements.title: Default budget
requirements.statement: Use a default maximum output budget of 1,500 tokens.
evidence: Task/golden budget audit: budget distribution={1500: 217, 2500: 19}; 217 tasks use 1,500.

requirements.title: Large-set budget
requirements.statement: Permit large set-completeness tasks to use budgets up to approximately 2,500 tokens.
evidence: Task/golden budget audit: 18 large category-5 sets and eight-item T235 use 2,500.

requirements.title: Proportional headroom
requirements.statement: Size each budget to at least approximately three to four times a concise rendering of its required concepts.
evidence: Task/golden budget audit: largest concise golden bundle is far below 2,500; all 1,500 budgets exceed 4× concise concept text.

requirements.title: Transcript-scale separation
requirements.statement: Keep every task budget far below the transcript size.
evidence: All task budgets are ≤2,500 tokens versus 46925 user-agent transcript tokens.

requirements.title: Golden answer sufficiency
requirements.statement: Ensure the complete golden bundle contains enough memory for a capable downstream agent to answer or act without asking the user for missing organization-specific context.
evidence: source_assets/task_semantic_audit.json passes 236/236 complete bundles; validation/oracle_results.jsonl has 236 task+golden-only gate-4 executions with no clarification dependency.

requirements.title: No inaccessible support
requirements.statement: Ensure every supporting fact ID maps to one or more transcript spans before the task snapshot.
evidence: task_semantic_audit snapshot_support passes every required/alternative/optional/stale/confidential fact; all resolve in world/facts.jsonl and accepted span_map positions at/before the task snapshot.

acceptance: PASS: all 236 exact section 5–7 requirements pass on the final stable executable/artifact snapshot.
